---
name: A cut sounds wrong
about: A pad starts late, clips a word, or runs on too long
title: 'Cut: '
labels: cut
---

**Which pad?**
Bank and name, for example "Bank A, LINE 1" or "Bank B, CHOP 07".

**Which way is it off?**

- [ ] Starts too early (it catches the end of what came before)
- [ ] Starts too late (the first word or hit is clipped)
- [ ] Ends too early
- [ ] Ends too late (it runs into what comes next)

**By roughly how much?**
A guess is fine: "half a word", "about a beat".

**Anything else you hear**
